title: ChatGPT Welcomes GPT-6 and a New Intelligent Interface: Answers Are Not Just Text Any More, They Can Also Directly Generate Interactive Tools

content_html:
OpenAI has officially launched the GPT-6 model and simultaneously introduced a new "intelligent interface" feature, completely revolutionizing the traditional pure text conversation mode. The system can now generate interactive components such as charts, clickable buttons, forms, and even dynamic calculators based on the user's specific questions.

For example, in daily conversations, users can ask the system to create an AA sharing tool, calculator, or game on the spot, and perform operations and interactions directly within the chat window. This upgrade breaks the traditional AI response format limitations, allowing the model to present complex information in the most intuitive and user-friendly way.

Thinking and outputting simultaneously, covering all types of users

In addition to the major innovations in the interface, GPT-6 also introduces a new "thinking and outputting simultaneously" mechanism. When processing complex questions or performing online searches, the model can generate parts of the content immediately without waiting for the entire thought process to finish, significantly reducing user wait time.

This update is currently being rolled out to Plus, Pro, and enterprise users, and it is planned to be available to free and Go version users in a short period of time. Through this technological advancement, OpenAI is moving ChatGPT from a simple text assistant to a fully functional visual interaction platform.
